lede: Cars N Such is a car workshop in Jalan Lam Huat and Carros Centre. Its own website lists minor and major servicing, engine oil, transmission oil and repairs and maintenance.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention careful diagnosis of error codes and fault lights explained in plain words, help with older cars, transparent quotes on WhatsApp and a respray of a Honda Civic.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, carsnsuch-sg.com.
makes_note: Named on its own website. Ask the workshop about other makes.
good_to_know: Online booking or enquiry form on its website
